flowchart TD
  subgraph Front["front"]

  subgraph Back["Backend Spring"]
    B --> C["BossController.java"]

  end
  subgraph Worker["Automatisation"]

explication: Le front Next.js appelle les controleurs Spring, qui passent par les services applicatifs puis par les workers. Boss.java pilote le navigateur via PlaywrightManager et la config est lue par les mappers.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Next.js front end calls the Spring controllers, which go through the application services and then the workers. Boss.java drives the browser via PlaywrightManager and the configuration is read by the mappers.
